task.title: How to Simplify Software Dashboards for Managers and Developers

user_message.content: I am having to manage issues that all of our mangers and regional managers are having with their software dashboards and running the system can i get you reference my managers list and my property directory and come up with a n easy system to use that i can give access to our developers/programmers

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content:
I'd love to help you build an issue tracking system for your managers and developers! To get started, I have a few questions:

1. **Where is your managers list and property directory stored?** For example, are they in Notion, Monday.com, ClickUp, a spreadsheet, or another format? Could you share the links or files?

2. **What kind of system are you looking for?** For example:
   - A web-based issue tracker (like a mini help desk) where managers can submit dashboard/software issues
   - A project board in an existing tool (Monday.com, ClickUp, Notion) to track and assign issues to developers
   - A standalone app with a form for submitting issues and a dashboard for developers to manage them

3. **What information should be captured per issue?** For example: manager name, property/location, issue type, priority, description, screenshots, etc.

4. **How should developers receive and manage issues?** Should they get email notifications, work from a board view, or something else?

Feel free to share the links to your managers list and property directory and I'll take it from there based on your default needs!

## 🖥️ Software Dashboard Issue Tracker — Setup Complete

### ClickUp Board
**Link:** [https://app.clickup.com/90141033101/v/l/li/901416027349](https://app.clickup.com/90141033101/v/l/li/901416027349)

Located in the **Apartment Corp Workspace** under a new folder called **🖥️ Software Dashboard Issue Tracker**, with 4 separate lists:

| List | Coverage |
|---|---|
| 📋 All Issues | Master view — every issue across all regions |
| 🟠 Region 2 Issues (TX / OH) | Grace Townhomes, La Promesa, Breckenridge Village, Lexington Arms, Grove Park Terrace, River Pointe Apts |
| 🟢 Region 3 Issues (NC) | Thomasville Church Homes, Silver Springs Terrace Apts |
| 🔵 CA Region Issues | Urban Rehab 1 & 2, Midtown Manor, Fairfax Senior Apts, River Garden, Granite Ridge Apts, Pacific Pointe Apts, Oak Hills Apts, Forest View Senior Apts |

**Statuses:** New Issue → In Progress → Needs Info → Testing / QA → Resolved

---

### Monday.com Board
**Link:** [https://apartmentcorp-company.monday.com/boards/18411186325](https://apartmentcorp-company.monday.com/boards/18411186325)

Located in the **Main Workspace** with groups for each region and the following columns pre-built:

| Column | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Status | New Issue / Working on it / Done / Stuck |
| Priority | Urgent / High / Normal / Low |
| Region | Region 2, Region 3, CA Region |
| Property | Property name |
| Manager Name | Who reported it |
| Manager Email | Direct contact |
| Issue Description | Full details of the problem |
| Assigned Developer | Who is working on it |
| Date Reported | When it was submitted |
| Date Resolved | When it was fixed |

**Groups:** 🟠 Region 2 (TX/OH) · 🟢 Region 3 (NC) · 🔵 CA Region · ✅ Resolved Issues

---

### How to Use (Quick Reference)

**For Managers** — When you have a software dashboard issue:
1. Go to your region's list/group and create a new item
2. Fill in: your name, property, a description of the issue, and set the priority
3. Attach a screenshot if you can

**For Developers** — When working an issue:
1. Assign yourself and move status to **In Progress / Working on it**
2. Use **Needs Info / Stuck** if you need clarification from the manager
3. Move to **Testing / QA** when the fix is deployed
4. Mark **Resolved / Done** when confirmed fixed

---

Both boards include a **📌 "How to Submit an Issue — Read First"** pinned item with the full guide for both managers and developers. Sample issues have been added to each region to demonstrate the format. You can share the board links directly with your managers and developers to get started right away!
